Yes. A **candidate tree-cover loss of 13.5 ha** was detected in 2025, covering about 3.9% of the property. The finding is **pending corroboration**: 2025 is the latest observed year, so a later year is needed to assess whether the change persists.

No loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected from 2021 through 2024. The 2025 detection does not establish the cause, whether deforestation or land-use change occurred, or whether any activity was legal.
